## Blue Emerald — G4 background Pegasus

**Who she is:** A pale mint-green Pegasus mare with a blue mane and tail and brown eyes, glimpsed in a blue weather-team vest alongside Rainbow Dash's flyers during *Winter Wrap Up* (season 1, episode 11, approximately 15:59). She shares the Sassaflash/Parasol-style model, so her colors distinguish her from similar background mares.

**Name and continuity:** She appears in the official *Friendship Is Magic* episode, but **“Blue Emerald” is a fan/wiki identification**, not a name spoken onscreen or verified from official merchandise. An archived screencap is also tagged “Meadow Rain”; that tag alone does not establish an official alias or alter ego. A palette-matching Gameloft texture has been reported, but does not establish a named playable appearance.

**Voice and appearances:** *Winter Wrap Up* is her documented TV appearance. No individual dialogue, credited voice actor, or distinct singing part is verified.

**Images and credits:** [Blue Emerald identification still (episode screenshot; My Little Pony Wiki file page)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File:Blue_Emerald_ID_S1E11.png) · [Cropped episode still tagged “Blue Emerald” and “Meadow Rain” (Ponerpics post)](https://ponerpics.org/images/2222525). These are show frames, not independently attributed fan illustrations; the archives are hosts, not the animation's creators. No reliably attributable standalone fan artwork or verified direct image file URL was found.
